description: Get the latest US rig count (Baker Hughes). Use when the user asks about drilling activity, rig counts, or oil field operations. Returns a single US total rig count with its region and observation date — this source carries no oil/gas split and no prior-week delta. For rigs broken out by US/Canada/international alongside frac spreads and permits, use opa_get_drilling. No parameters needed. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.
name: opa_get_rig_counts
title: Get US Rig Counts
